description: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B Q8_0 by bartowski
gpu_tip: ~36GB total, and that number barely moves with context length — Nemotron 3.5's hybrid Mamba/MoE design keeps KV cache tiny (only 6 attention layers, 2 KV heads) even at its full 262K window. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it via llama.cpp's MoE expert offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~36GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably; tight on 36GB.
